name: Hormel / DHL Southaven Distribution Center - Southaven MS

fieldNotes.location: Roster coords (34.988048,-90.040999) landed in the correct industrial park (geocode flagged 6135 m moved). Confirmed via the 8690 Tulane Rd address and web reporting: this is the former Associated Wholesale Grocers (AWG) distribution center in Southaven, MS, renovated (>$12M) and reopened in 2025 as Hormel's largest DC, operated by DHL Supply Chain. Locked center 34.98820,-90.04100 on the large white-roofed warehouse.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The truck yard is fully enclosed by a barbed-wire-topped chain-link fence (StreetView 2025-04 and 2025-12). A chain-link gate (flanked by yellow bollards) controls the truck drive entrance on the SW side. truckGate true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard-booth structure was positively confirmed at the truck gate. A small structure exists inside the yard but does not read as a gatehouse beside the gate. Classified guardShack false; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Modern DHL-operated DC with a fenced gated yard and no confirmed guard booth -> remote/kiosk/app check-in implied -> remoteGs true.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+ dock doors -- long continuous dock banks on the west and south building faces (former AWG grocery DC). Banded 50+, honest overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ untethered trailers parked across the large fenced truck yard -> dropArea 50+.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Extensive on-site fenced trailer-storage yard distinct from the active dock apron -> dropYard true.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Large fenced yard provides a deep approach able to stack many trucks before the docks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide paved gate apron and yard leave clear room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Southaven MS is part of the Memphis metro; the DC sits in a dense suburban industrial park -> Urban.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Single very large warehouse building (multi-section roof) -> buildingCount 1.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on two faces but operated as one DC flow; no clear separate ship/receive split -> shipRcvSeparate false.
